description: Recent Mentions (forwards each completed main-loop answer in a folder bound to an outline to that outline's mentions.ingest), clickable references, Recent mentions as a band or pane beside the transcript with door-drawn block previews (BlockView), the show tool, workboard and outline tools over the installed Outliner CLI, drawn in the transcript as compact rows that fold open on what they wrote, door tools in an ep0ch-door tile, where the session runs (ep0ch where) as context, where this Claude is bound (outline, machine, door, folder) as a card, a status line and context, the workboard now (build log, lanes, waiting on the person, open PRs) as context at the start and after a compaction, a session running twice (two processes on one session id, from claude agents) said on the status line and with the first prompt, and what the outline can hold (every component it has, ep0ch library --guide) as context, with the core outline tools listed up front and a written figure drawn back into the write's result
